blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — An anti-Marcos coalition staged a rally at the Edsa Shrinen on Monday, the 54th anniversary of the declaration of martial law. The rallyists also denounced the recent Supreme Court (SC) ruling overturning former first lady Imelda R. Marcos’ conviction for graft cases related to alleged ill-gotten wealth. Monday’s rally also marked the second iteration of Sept. 21 protests which began last year over a multi-billion corruption scandal involving flood control projects.
